messages:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INFR-AUTO-112 — inference-queue backlog > 3k, p95 latency 4x baseline, autoscaler error rate increased :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident assigned to oncall: alex. Escalation policy: infra-autoscale. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENT/INFR-AUTO-112
alex: Ack. looking now. tagging @jamie and @priya for infra + scheduler help
jamie: I'm tailing autoscaler logs — seeing a burst of 429s from provider API during instance creates. provider response: "RateLimitExceeded: exceeded instance create quota per minute"
priya: That would explain scaling stalls. Are there pending pods piling up?
alex: Yes — check queue-controller pods: many in Pending complaining about nodeSelector constraints.
taylor: Quick check: queue length by class: realtime=2200, batch=950. CPU per-replica backlog rising. Customer impact: increased latencies and a handful of 504s reported by a customer (CS ticket #4578).
jamie: Posting log excerpt:
```
2025-09-03T18:01:22Z autoscaler[pool-manager] INFO create_attempt instance_type=g5.xlarge req=4
2025-09-03T18:01:24Z provider_api ERROR 429 RateLimitExceeded: createInstance rate limit
2025-09-03T18:01:24Z autoscaler WARN backoff=30s attempt=1
```
jamie: Provider quota looks saturated due to many small spikes earlier today. Cloud console shows short-term burst limit hit for us-west-2.
carla-cs: FYI CS seeing ~8% of requests get timeouts for a handful of enterprise customers — they're pinging for updates.
alex: Mitigation plan: 1) try manual create with alternative instance type (lower quota usage path) 2) enable degraded routing for non-enterprise tenants to smaller model to reduce token usage 3) notify PD and customers. Who can try manual spin?
jamie: I'll try alternative instance family (g4 -> g3 equivalent) and also start a manual create of a small reserve pool. Running: `infractl pool create --name=reserve-warm --count=4 --instance=g4dn.xlarge --zone=us-west-2a`
priya: Meanwhile I'll temporarily relax nodeSelector on queue pods so they can land on any compatible nodes (will reduce affinity strictness).
jamie: Manual create failed first due to the same rate limit, but switching to a different AZ reduced throttling. Created 2 nodes in us-west-2b: node-aux-01, node-aux-02.
jamie: Command run:
```
infractl provider create-instances --type=g4dn.xlarge --count=2 --region=us-west-2b --tags=reserve-warm
=> success: instance ids i-0a1b2c, i-0d3e4f
```
alex: Nice. Priya, confirm pods scheduling to new nodes?
priya: Pods starting to bind, p95 latency on queue-controller down ~30% after nodes join. Still a backlog but trending down.
aylor: (typo) sorry meant taylor earlier
carla-cs: Notifying affected customers with a short statement: "We are mitigating a capacity-related degradation — routing and capacity increases in progress, updates every 30m."
jamie: Root cause hypothesis: provider per-minute create quota hit from multiple churn events earlier (deploys + test churn). Autoscaler doesn't have backoff coordination across pools so it retried and hit the limit. Need to add smarter pacing + multi-AZ fallback.
alex: Agreed. For now, continue manual nodes until queue dips under threshold. Keep PD incident open until steady for 15m. PR to follow for autoscaler pacing. Who will own the postmortem?
priya: I'll own the postmortem and include action items: quota-aware pacing, AZ fallback, reserve warm pool health checks.
jamie: I'll open provider support case to request short-term increase on create rate and document what we saw.
carla-cs: Update sent to customers. Will coordinate further comms if impact persists.
alex: Thanks team. Next update in 10 minutes or on state change. :white_check_mark:
